title: Bix Caleen
description: Bix Caleen ran a successful business on the planet of Ferrix, pulling apart old scrap and selling off the component pieces to the right people. The business also served as a front for rebellious activity, which got her into more trouble than she expected. Brave, bold, and loyal, she had a soft spot for friends like Cassian Andor, always trying to help him build a better life while working to improve the galaxy.
